page.layout: One block of centred title lines in the middle of the page; below it, at the foot, a short line in two widely spaced parts.
page.notes: The foot line is small, worn and partly illegible: its left part looks like a short two-letter mark and its right part like the end of a word in small capitals ("ERUM" is the likeliest reading of the right part). Page has no page number, running head or catchword. No engraving.
